summaryJa: 1957年10月13日22:05（東部標準時）、ミシガン州モンロー郡レイク・エリーのIndian Trails付近で、15歳のHarry Poe Jr.とDale Smith（共に学生）がUFOを目撃したとする米空軍情報報告。目撃物は鐘形、バスケットボール大、銀灰色で単独。貫通孔様の灯りが四つ（うち二つが半見え）、高音のハム音（電動発電機のよう）を伴い、上下面を分ける太い線が見えたと記載。約1500フィートの高度で水平になり、SSWからNNEへ直進、所要8–10秒、報告内に225 MPHと記載あり。視程は無制限、天候は快晴、2000フィートで160°から10ノットの風。報告はTSgt. Rudy Goldが準備、文書には機密保護と複製禁止の注意書きあり。
summaryEn: Air Intelligence report dated 13 October 1957 at 22:05 Eastern: two 15-year-old witnesses (Harry Poe Jr. and Dale Smith, students) observed a UFO near Indian Trails on Lake Erie, Monroe County, Michigan. The object is described as bell-shaped, about basketball size, silver-grey, single, with four lights (two partially visible), a high-pitched hum like an electric generator, and a heavy line dividing top and bottom. It reportedly leveled at about 1,500 feet, passed from SSW to NNE in a straight line, lasted 8–10 seconds, and the report notes a speed of about 225 MPH. Conditions: clear sky, unlimited visibility, wind at 2,000 ft from 160° at 10 knots. Report prepared by TSgt. Rudy Gold; document includes Espionage-law warning and reproduction restrictions.
